title: Blanket weather + chocolate fondue 🧶🍫
description:
When it's cozy blanket weather it's time for Harry Potter season.

The chocolate brown Meltie Mini Fondue Mug on a library side table: malt balls in, tealight lit, strawberries dipped and dripping. A mini chocolate fondue in one mug for movie nights, cosy evenings and gifts.
